missing: P1S-specific peak and steady draw with a sized UPS or power station pick, measured ride-through minutes for the P1S (with and without AMS), switchover time/waveform compatibility, and current prices.
why: Every result is a Bambu forum or Reddit thread or an AI troubleshooting stub; no major reviewer, authority, or even a niche comparison site has tested UPS or power station options for a Bambu printer. The threads scatter useful fragments (CyberPower 1000W, GoldenMate LiFePO4 units, P2S/H2D peak draws, one P1S anecdote) but nobody gives a P1S-sized pick with ride-through time. A focused page with P1S draw figures, a short list of UPS/power station picks with runtime at P1S load, prices and codes would be the clear best source.
